featured_reviews.name: Pradnya Rambade
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently stayed at Fisherman Village for a monsoon staycation, and it turned out to be a really refreshing and peaceful experience. The moment we entered the property, the entire place felt calm, scenic, and surrounded by nature. Since we visited during the rainy season, everything looked extra beautiful — lush greenery, cloudy weather, the peaceful lake view, and ducks swimming around made the atmosphere feel straight out of a nature retreat.

One of the best parts of the stay was the ambience. The property has a very relaxing vibe, perfect for taking a break from the city rush. Sitting near the lake with light rain and cool weather felt extremely soothing. The view throughout the property was beautiful, especially during the evenings and early mornings. If you enjoy nature, monsoon is definitely the best time to visit.❤️

The food was also very good. The meals were fresh, tasty, and comforting, which added a lot to the overall experience. The staff was polite and welcoming, and the stay overall felt smooth and comfortable.✨

What we loved most was how peaceful and well-maintained the place felt. Whether it was walking around the property, enjoying the lake view, or simply relaxing with family and friends, the entire experience was memorable.🫶🏼

Overall, it was a wonderful staycation experience with beautiful views, good food, and a calm atmosphere. We genuinely enjoyed our stay and would definitely love to visit again, especially during the monsoon season. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a relaxing getaway near nature.👌

Had such a lovely experience at Fisherman Village Resort! 🌴✨
The entire vibe of the place was peaceful, relaxing, and perfect for a short getaway. The property is beautiful, well-maintained, and the atmosphere genuinely makes you feel refreshed. Food, ambience, and overall hospitality were really good.

A special mention to one of the staff members who was extremely patient, polite, and helpful throughout our stay. They handled everything so calmly and made sure we were comfortable the entire time. Staff like that truly make a place memorable.

Thank you for such a nice experience would definitely love to visit again! 💛

featured_reviews.name: Pravin Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
We stayed at Fisherman Village Resort recently. The place looks nice and the location is good, but a few things spoiled the trip.
The pool smelled strongly of chlorine and felt over-chlorinated. Also saw broken tiles inside the pool — not safe.
Food was disappointing for the price. Most gravies tasted the same (sweet and very red), and the bar had limited options with high prices.
Room was just okay. AC was leaking, the TV switchboard wasn’t fixed, and we heard a sparking noise from TV switch— that felt unsafe.
Room rate only includes breakfast, so you’ll pay extra for lunch and dinner.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Anant Fish Market in Nallasopara often gain popularity for several reasons:

1. **Fresh Seafood:** Markets that consistently offer fresh and high-quality seafood tend to attract customers seeking top-notch products.

2. **Variety of Seafood:** A diverse selection of fish and seafood can contribute to a market's popularity, providing customers with a range of choices.

3. **Local Sourcing:** Markets that source seafood locally, potentially directly from fishermen, may have a reputation for authenticity and supporting the local economy.

4. **Competitive Pricing:** If the market offers competitive prices for its seafood products, it can become a go-to destination for residents in the area.

5. **Clean and Well-Managed:** Cleanliness and a well-organized setup contribute to a positive shopping experience, attracting more customers.

6. **Community Recommendations:** Positive word-of-mouth and recommendations from the local community can significantly enhance the market's popularity.

featured_reviews.name: Lalita
featured_reviews.review_text:
Capital Mall, Vasai was honestly my go-to place for shopping while I was in Vasai, mainly because there aren’t too many other good shopping or hangout options nearby. While it’s definitely smaller compared to many malls in Mumbai/Delhi, it still manages to offer a decent overall experience and is a great addition to the area.

In terms of shopping, there are a few prominent brands available—for example, The Body Shop, which is a nice find here. From the collection and variety point of view, I felt Pantaloons had the best range, especially when it comes to clothing options. Zudio clearly has the highest footfall; the pricing and collection are quite good and enjoyable for casual shopping.

Apart from shopping, there’s also a gaming zone, which adds to the entertainment options. The mall has PVR for movies—it gives the mall a premium touch. I personally never ended up watching a movie here, but it’s definitely a big plus and makes the mall feel more complete.

The food court was the main highlight for me. It genuinely doesn’t disappoint. You have good pizza chains, quick meal options like Box8 (Desi Meals), plus donuts, chai, and a few other snack/dessert/meal varieties. There’s enough choice for everyone, and it’s a great place to relax after shopping.
We celebrated Women’s day and birthdays here.

One downside though—getting autos/cabs in the evening is very difficult; fares are extremely high. It’s better to drive your own vehicle if you’re planning to visit, especially later in the day.

Overall, despite being a smaller mall, Capital Mall is a great addition to Vasai and serves as a solid shopping + food + entertainment destination.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for sharing your feedback. We are glad that you appreciate our offerings, we constantly strive to enhance your experience! We hope to see you again at Capital!

featured_reviews.name: Bhumi Chitroda
featured_reviews.review_text:
Capital Mall Review

Capital Mall is a well-designed and lively shopping destination that offers a complete experience for shopping, food, and entertainment. The mall has a modern layout with spacious corridors, good lighting, and a clean, well-maintained environment, making it comfortable to explore even during peak hours.

It features a good mix of branded stores, local outlets, and daily-use shops, so there’s something for every budget. Fashion, accessories, electronics, and lifestyle stores are neatly organized, making shopping easy and enjoyable. The food court is another highlight, offering a variety of options ranging from fast food to casual dining, perfect for families, friends, and office-goers.

Capital Mall is also a great place for entertainment, with options like a cinema and kids’ play areas, making it suitable for all age groups. Security arrangements are proper, and facilities like parking, elevators, and restrooms are well managed.

Overall, Capital Mall is more than just a shopping place—it’s a complete hangout spot where you can shop, eat, relax, and spend quality time. Whether you’re visiting for a quick purchase or a full day outing, Capital Mall provides a pleasant and convenient experience worth visiting again.

featured_reviews.name: पराग घरत
featured_reviews.review_text:
An important place that attracts fish lovers is the Virar East fish market under Vasai Virar Municipal Corporation placed on main road next to Totale Talaw main gate next to Virar East Police Station.

A variety of fresh fishes are available here daily. Those with good bargaining skill get good deals along with fresh fishes here; else one have to pay high price as well.
For fresh fishes you can visit the market early morning 8:30 AM to 9:00 AM or early evening like 5:30 PM.

The market entry is very cunsusted and narrow. As this building is in main market area both two and four wheeler parking is not available outside. Considering maintainance and hygiene this fish market is too unhygienic and have lack of maintainance. Emergency exits not available for the market hall.
